title: MULACHAA FI OLDEEMISA YESOO
paragraphs: Oboleeyan lama ta dira Emmau, akka Yesoni wolwoldeete gulyaatota Yesoti himte, ato worri waan kana hasau, Yesoni jiddu worraa ejate waan jed'eeni, “Nageenni isanii haa tau” worri guddo sodate nahe, waan ekhera argani sehani. Ammo inni waan worraani jed'e, “Maafi naatani? Maafi garaa keesani keesati birefattani? Harkafi miila kiyya ilaala, aka nami naa. Naa qabad'a ilaala, imbeetani ekheraani aka kiyya kana nafafi lafele inqabdu.” Akasi jennaani harkafi miila agarsiise. Duuba mamani gammadani akanaani d'ugefachu dad'abani, tanaafi inni waan jed'eeni, “waan nyaatani arma qabdu.” Qurt'umi diqo ta wodani iti kennani, inni fuud'e worra durati nyaate.

Duuba inni waan worraani jed'e, “Tunini dubbi tiyya ta anini isaniini jed'e, ato isani woliini jiru; wonti ti kiyya ta kitaaba Seera Musatifi ka raagootatiifi ka Faaru keesati t'aafani ch'ufti guutamu malte.” Jennaani inni qalbi worraa bane, aka waan t'aafani hubatani, waan jed'eeni, “wonti t'aafani, tana; Kristoni gaargale guyya sadeeso kau male, aka haga Yerusalemu iti keyatani iraa deebitifi araarama daba maqa isatiini gosa ch'ufati odeesu malani. Isaniti d'uga waan kanati. Ilaala, waan Abbaani kiyya isaniti kakhate anati isanii erga, ammo dira keesati eega, haga jabeenni gubba isanii gad'ufuti.”

Jennaani haga Bethania worra geese, harka olfud'ate eebiseefi. Isa arginaani guddisani, ato nami gari d'arefatele. Yesoni worrati d'iaate waan jed'eeni: “Jabeenna ch'ufa, ka lafafi gubbale, ya nati kennani. Tanaafi fulla ch'ufa yaa, gosa ch'ufa nama kiyya tolcha: maqa Abbaatiifi ka ilmaatiifi ka Lubbu Qulqullotini aada batiso namaa kenna, waan anini isani barsiise ch'ufa guuta worraani jed'a. Beekha, haga guyya muummele anini isani woliini jira.” Worri isa guddise, Yerusalemuti gammadaani dachaani, hojja ch'ufa Mana Waaqa keesati Waaqa faarsani.
